summary: Read-only check of the family-pattern PDF comparison. (1) I read all 81 entries on the 3 page images (page1_hi/page2_hi/page3_hi, cropped into quarters) and compared each one with docs/source/pdf_transcription.json: wife family, husband family and result. 81/81 match, with no transcription errors. Case 71 (wife F, husband F M F, result F), 84 (wife M F M, husband F, result F), 87 (wife F M F, husband M, result M) and 92 (wife M F F, husband M, result M) all match the image. Numbering is confirmed as 1-29 on page 1, 41-67 on page 2 and 68-92 on page 3. Page 1 has the note 'الأرقام من 30 إلى 40 غير موجودة في النص المرسل' and the header with the 70-90% / 50-60% ranges. (2) I checked every claim in FAMILY_PATTERN_PDF_COMPARISON.md against family_pattern_table.json and family_pattern_analysis(), and against the API for 84, 87 and 92. All claims are correct. GENOVA has 72 entries and its extra case numbers are exactly 30-40. Cases 1-29 match on families and on both first and second results. Cases 41-60 and 69-80 match on the combined pattern and the result, with first == second. Cases 61-68 fall back to 53/60/56/57/55/58/54/59, which are 1+2 entries, and give the PDF answer. For cases 81-92 the cases GENOVA falls back to (69, 51, 50, 75, 71, 80, 72, 79, 73, 78, 70, none) match the document's table. Only 84 (GENOVA male vs PDF F), 87 (GENOVA female vs PDF M) and 92 (no table match) differ. The PDF has 81 unique (wife, husband) pairs. (3) git status/diff on backend/genova/traditional is empty, so no code or data changed. (4) Regression: backend pytest 214 passed; frontend jest 23 passed (4 suites).

minor.issue: Cosmetic only: the OCR 'raw' strings still contain typos (case 48 'أنتى', case 71 'أنتثى'). The structured wife/husband/result fields are correct.
Wording nuance: for case 92 GENOVA returns no outcome, but details.original_fallback='male', which equals the PDF answer M. The report could mention that the legacy fallback happens to agree.

The 30/min analysis rate limit is shared per user. Live-API tests that run in the same minute as other API-heavy tests can get rate-limited and fail with KeyError 'result'. This happened in my first full run. It is not a product bug.

action_items: None blocking. The comparison report is accurate and can be sent to the owner for approval. Optionally: clean the OCR 'raw' typos and mention the case-92 legacy fallback (male).
